lines.text: Every organisation has weaknesses it can't see. And one is often all it takes to put your most valuable data at risk.
But what if you found that path first?
Meet HexaStrike AI penetration testing, built into HexaView.
It thinks like an attacker, mapping your weaknesses and the routes between them, before anyone else can.
So you fix what matters, close the path, and stop the attack before it happens.
Guard-railed by design: exclusions, rate limits and a stop button, with every finding reviewed by an analyst.
Scoping takes minutes. Choose what to test, and the effort is calculated from your own estate.
Your quote updates live, so you know the price before you commit.
Authorise it with a signed letter, right inside HexaView.
Then watch it run live. Every phase, every finding, and the attack path as it's validated.
When it's done, your report builds itself, ready to sign off and share.
Then fix, retest and prove it's closed. Every finding is tracked until it's gone, and turned into a detection.
So when someone comes looking for a way in, there isn't one.
HexaStrike, by HexaShield. Stop the attack before it happens.
